column1: # SilikOS: the PCI drivers built into EL 9.8's kernel (x86_64 5.14.0-687.66.2.el9_8: modules.builtin). A built-in driver has no
# line in modules.alias, so its ID table is written here, read from the kernel's source. Input of tools/gen_hwdb.py.
# alias: a PCI modalias pattern, as modules.alias has them; module; arch: both, x86_64 or aarch64; source: the table read.
# The thunderbolt and vmd rows are the aliases of the same drivers in Fedora 45's kernel 7.2.11 (where they are modules)
# whose device ID is also in the EL 9 source file named (checked by text on 2026-11-13); the others are class matches.
